Issue Number: close #36311

Problem Summary:

### What is changed and how it works?

This PR solves the problem of extra tso cmd requests after the PR https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/35158.

We have an optimization for not fetch tso from PD for `point get for update` related operations including operating includes them (update, delete and so on). However, it is missed in prepare-pattern. This PR supplements it.

Tso cmd request counts are not related to the correctness of the programme and have not been covered by the current unit tests. This PR also adds the related unit test to avoid similar mistakes in the future.

issue_context.title: Refactoring of sessiontxn introduces extra TSO waits
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

```
func TestTSO(t *testing.T) {
	store, clean := testkit.CreateMockStore(t)
	defer clean()
	tk := testkit.NewTestKit(t, store)
	tk.MustExec("use test")
	tk.MustExec("drop table if exists t")
	tk.MustExec("create table t(id int, v int, primary key (id), key i1(v))")
	tk.MustExec("create table t2(id int, v int, primary key (id), key i1(v))")
	tk.MustExec("insert into t values (1, 1)")
	tk.MustExec("begin pessimistic")
	tk.MustExec("select * from t where id = 1 for update")
	tk.MustExec("update t set v = v + 1 where id = 1")
	tk.MustExec("insert into t2 values (1, 1)")
	tk.MustExec("commit")
}

```
<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

Before #35885, the test consists of 21 tso waits (that in `changePendingToValid`).

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

With #35885, the test needs 91 tso waits.

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->
